research_question: Can a verified future response-form agreement be stored as a typed observable-trigger to response-policy relation and later select the intended branch across morphology and bounded paraphrase, under the same-model current-turn baseline controls?
single_core_variable: M37 adds typed trigger-relation extraction, support-gated persistence, and current-trigger matching. It does not change feedback correction linkage, Japanese surface-act verification, base model, persona contract, factual-memory authority, or final visible-language guard.

operational_definition.relation_candidate: one future or recurring conditional marker, exactly one bounded observable trigger predicate, and exactly one explicit response-form policy in the seed turn
operational_definition.verification: the next user turn must decisively support the seed response prediction before the relation becomes reusable
operational_definition.current_match: a later turn independently expresses the same typed trigger predicate; raw seed wording and the seed turn's request act are not required
operational_definition.unknown_boundary: unrecognized, multiple, or current-only predicates do not create a reusable relation

conditions.baseline: qwen3.5:9b receives only the current visible turn and the shared public-Uruha expression contract; it does not receive seed history, verified trigger relations, system trace, or selected policy
conditions.system: the same qwen3.5:9b realizes the authoritative response branch selected from the verified M37 typed trigger relation

reserve.pair_rule: current_input is byte-identical inside each pair; seed trigger meaning is held constant while the explicitly requested future response policy changes
reserve.surface_rule: seed and current trigger wording must differ; exact reserve sentences must not be added to runtime code
reserve.post_seal_rule: do not edit reserve wording, labels, predicates, thresholds, or pair membership after this protocol is frozen

controlled_variables: byte-identical current utterance within each counterfactual pair
same public-Uruha expression and natural-Japanese-visible contract
same output token budget and local machine
paired real prompt-token difference at most two tokens
same current-turn baseline prompt family as M35/M36
no feedback-linkage or semantic-surface-act remediation in M37

scored_outputs.relation_candidate: seed predicate and response policy are separated and traced before feedback
scored_outputs.relation_persistence: support creates one raw-free verified relation with provenance digest and history
scored_outputs.relation_match: later morphology or bounded paraphrase independently matches the stored trigger predicate
scored_outputs.mechanism_current_policy: system branch policy before language realization
scored_outputs.same_model_current_policy: baseline and system selected-policy declarations under paired token audit
scored_outputs.current_surface: observable policy-specific Japanese surface proxy, separate from policy and relation scores
scored_outputs.pair_test: baseline remains invariant for byte-identical current input while the system diverges under different verified trigger relations

required_development_regressions: M36 English bounce-around seed matches a later bouncing predicate without exact-sentence code
conditional trigger and requested response policy are stored as separate typed fields
current-only arousal language does not create a reusable future relation
unsupported relation candidates are not reusable
M36 annotation integrity, M34 revision, protected routes, raw-free persistence, persona, and visible Japanese do not regress
claim_boundary: a pass supports only controlled source-disjoint evidence that verified trigger relations survive the implemented morphology and paraphrase families; it does not establish private-intent truth, open-domain semantic equivalence, human felt-understanding preference, general LLM superiority, or a human-brain equation
post_result_rule: do not modify M37 runtime, evaluator, model prompts, reserve, protocol, thresholds, labels, or formal raw result from M37 reserve outcomes; failures move to M38 or a separately named milestone
